description: timeline example, in the web adapter

files.content:
import "@/components/audio-ui/timeline/web";

/** Draws the timeline into `element`, and returns what takes it away. */
export function timelineWebDemo(element: HTMLElement) {
  element.innerHTML = `
    <audio-ui-timeline class="[--timeline-grid-color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--border)_70%,transparent)] [--timeline-grid-accent-color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_16%,transparent)] flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col data-disabled:opacity-50" duration="32" snap-step="1">
      <audio-ui-timeline-viewport class="bg-background relative min-h-0 min-w-0 overscroll-x-contain">
        <audio-ui-timeline-ruler aria-label="Position" class="h-7 border-b bg-background text-muted-foreground text-xs has-focus-visible:bg-muted h-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer touch-none select-none"></audio-ui-timeline-ruler>
        <audio-ui-timeline-lane class="h-14 border-b bg-muted/30 h-16">
          <audio-ui-timeline-playhead class="bg-primary pointer-events-none inset-y-0 w-px"></audio-ui-timeline-playhead>
          <audio-ui-timeline-clip aria-label="Kick" class="rounded-none overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="kick" default-value='{"start":2,"length":10,"offset":0,"fadeIn":0,"fadeOut":0}'>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-header class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="kick">Kick</audio-ui-timeline-clip-header>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start aria-label="Trim start of Kick" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="kick" edge="start"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end aria-label="Trim end of Kick" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="kick" edge="end"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end>
          </audio-ui-timeline-clip>
          <audio-ui-timeline-clip aria-label="Fill" class="rounded-none overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="fill" default-value='{"start":14,"length":8,"offset":0,"fadeIn":0,"fadeOut":0}'>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-header class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="fill">Fill</audio-ui-timeline-clip-header>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start aria-label="Trim start of Fill" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="fill" edge="start"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end aria-label="Trim end of Fill" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="fill" edge="end"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end>
          </audio-ui-timeline-clip>
        </audio-ui-timeline-lane>
        <audio-ui-timeline-lane class="h-14 border-b bg-muted/30 h-16">
          <audio-ui-timeline-playhead class="bg-primary pointer-events-none inset-y-0 w-px"></audio-ui-timeline-playhead>
          <audio-ui-timeline-clip aria-label="Bass" class="rounded-none overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="bass" default-value='{"start":6,"length":12,"offset":0,"fadeIn":0,"fadeOut":0}'>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-header class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed" clip="bass">Bass</audio-ui-timeline-clip-header>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start aria-label="Trim start of Bass" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="bass" edge="start"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-start>
            <audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end aria-label="Trim end of Bass" class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0" clip="bass" edge="end"></audio-ui-timeline-clip-trim-end>
          </audio-ui-timeline-clip>
        </audio-ui-timeline-lane>
      </audio-ui-timeline-viewport>
    </audio-ui-timeline>`;
  return () => {
    element.innerHTML = "";
  };
}

name: timeline-web-demo
